headline: Ankle-slappers on a good angle — dawn glass or skip it.
today: Barely there today, 0.6-0.9ft even if a longer-period SE line sneaks in. Your only shot is the dawn NE cross-off before the ESE cross-on fills in mid-morning and the SE/SSE wind ruins it by afternoon. Log if you must, otherwise sleep in.

daysToWatch.note: The one to watch. Swell jumps to near 4ft at 8s on a fair SSE angle, and morning wind swings NE cross-off. Grab a shortboard and go early before the evening onshore returns.
Chest-high SE at 8s on a good angle with dawn cross-off wind. Fun window early before the afternoon onshore.
